analysis_population.if_a_larger_resolution_tranche_is_availa: Use the full then-available frozen-pair tranche rather than stopping at 30.

failure_handling.interpretation: Any material asymmetric failure pattern is reported as an operational caveat and cannot be hidden by reporting only successful pairs.
failure_handling.score_eligible_pair_rule: Both frozen arm predictions must exist and the official outcome must be resolvable under the frozen dataset semantics.

methodological_effect: None. Does not alter forecasts, pair selection, model outputs, runner, probabilities, target binding, or frozen question snapshots.

primary_metric.definition: mean((p_control-y)^2 - (p_scope-y)^2) over score-eligible resolved pairs; positive favors SCOPE
primary_metric.name: paired_brier_advantage

purpose: Freeze the outcome/scoring interpretation path for the already-frozen ForecastBench Shadow-01 forecasts before any formal outcome interpretation.

reporting_guardrails.required_label: Late prospective shadow; not an official ForecastBench submission and not leaderboard-equivalent.

secondary_metrics.calibration: Report only where sample size supports it; descriptive for the first tranche.

paired_log_score_delta.definition: mean(log P_scope(realized) - log P_control(realized)) over score-eligible resolved pairs; positive favors SCOPE
paired_log_score_delta.rule: Floor is computational only; retain and disclose original probability including exact 0/1.

tail_risk: worst paired log-score delta where defined
frequency of extreme overconfidence / near-zero realized-outcome probability
distributional diagnostics by source_type when sample size supports it
